en: The front side of the postcard features two historical black-and-white images: the upper image shows a grand European-style mansion labeled as 'Двореца Евксиноградъ' (Euxinograd Palace); the lower image depicts partially ruined stone walls with several people, labeled as 'Стара Турска Крепость Кадиръ баба' (Old Turkish Fortress Kadir Baba). Both images have handwritten notes in several languages. The top of the card carries the text 'Gruss von Varna' and its Bulgarian equivalent, meaning 'Greetings from Varna.' The reverse side has printed address lines and postage markings, with Cyrillic text and a Bulgarian stamp dating from the early 1900s. It is addressed to Sofia, Bulgaria.
